description: Compact statistic display card showing a primary metric value, label, and optional secondary trend value with configurable color.

parameters.name: SubValue
parameters.description: Secondary value or trend indicator (e.g. "+12% this month").

parameters.name: SubValueColor
parameters.description: Colour for the SubValue, as a CSS colour value — a var(--tm-*) token reference, a hex literal (#16a34a), an rgb/hsl/oklch/color-mix function, or a named colour (seagreen). Rendered as the element's own --tm-stat-subvalue-color custom property, which the base .tm-stat-subvalue rule resolves with var(--tm-stat-subvalue-color, var(--tm-text-secondary)): the parameter therefore ALWAYS wins over the default colour, no matter where the consumer's stylesheet sits in source order. Only meaningful together with SubValue: without it there is nothing to colour and the card REFUSES to render (see OnParametersSet).

examples.title: Stat card with trend
examples.code:
<TmStatCard Title="Total Revenue"
            Value="$45,231"
            SubValue="+12.5% from last month"
            SubValueColor="var(--tm-color-success-text)" />
